# android-a11y-checks

> Accessibility rule engine for Android view and Compose semantics snapshots that reports touch target, contrast and labelling problems with WCAG 2.2 success criterion references Kotlin library `io.github.trysac:android-a11y-checks`, package
> `io.github.trysac.android_a11y_checks`, MIT licensed, Kotlin 2 on Java >= 21, standard library only.
